labels.name: kind/more-info-needed
labels.rationale: The report is missing required information: Prometheus version, configuration, and system details. These are necessary to reproduce or assess the issue.

items.body:
To help the maintainers understand and reproduce your report, could you please provide the following missing information:
- Prometheus version
- Prometheus configuration file
- System information (OS, architecture, etc.)

This will help us determine if any action is needed. Thank you!
